precursor preparation

Charge washed cores, oleylamine and OD

Charge washed cores, oleylamine and OD. Use washed CdSe cores, oleylamine and OD in a round-bottom flask. OD was selected to alleviate late-stage precipitation. Missing fields: individual core batch.

synthesis

Prepassivate Se-rich cores with one Cd monolayer equivalent

03
synthesis

Add separate S and Cd stocks with specified anneals and evolving Cd:OA ratios

Add separate S and Cd stocks with specified anneals and evolving Cd:OA ratios. Elemental sulfur and Cd-oleate stocks are in OD. Stock preparation details, stock volume and per-layer delivered volumes are not supplied. For the first 5–8 shell deposition cycles use Cd:oleic acid 1:4; use 1:10 for each succeeding layer. The exact switch cycle is not fixed. Grow at 240 °C, waiting one hour after sulfur and 2.5 hours after cadmium, until the desired shell thickness. This preferred protocol is separate from Table 1 comparison schedules. Missing fields: per-layer doses, exact switch cycle.

04
fractionation

Remove one percent after each completed cycle; keep planned precursor charges

Remove one percent after each completed cycle; keep planned precursor charges. Withdraw 1% of the total reaction solution after each completed monolayer, without reducing subsequent precursor quantities for the remaining dots. The percentage denotes removed reaction volume, not a fixed precursor molar excess. Missing fields: aliquot destination, layerwise remaining amount.

05
workup

Precipitate with ethanol and redisperse particles in hexane

Precipitate with ethanol and redisperse particles in hexane. Wash by ethanol precipitation and hexane redispersion two to three times. Relative emission QYs are measured against Rhodamine 6G from Acros; unspecified optical matching and purification conditions remain gaps. Missing fields: centrifuge settings, volumes, yield.
